summary: Describes a workflow for remote attestation of the integrity of firmware and software on network devices that contain a Trusted Platform Module or an equivalent. It is informational and sets the operational context for YANG work such as RFC 9684.

eli5.summary: A network device carries a tamper-proof notebook of what it has loaded. This explains how someone far away can read that notebook to check the device has not been secretly changed.

questions: how does remote attestation with a tpm work
